title: moderation_result
description: Written by the worker for a report photo (rpt_) or a cleanup after-photo (cln_), after the moderation gate, blurring and authenticity checks. Checks run in order and the first failure stops the chain; later checks are skipped. The original goes only to Rekognition.

report_id.description: rpt_ for a report photo, cln_ for a cleanup after-photo.

reasons.description: Empty when passed. invalid_image: not a decodable JPEG, over 8 MB, or bytes that do not match the client SHA-256.

blurred_key.description: Key of the blurred copy in the public bucket. Null when rejected before blurring.

blur.description: Faces and number plates blurred before any public copy exists. Null when rejected before blurring.

regions.description: Optional (v1.13). Every region blurred, by kind. faces and plates: detector boxes. heads: the top of a person box with no face found in it. plate_zones: the lower part of a vehicle box with no plate found in it. people and vehicles: whole DetectLabels boxes, blurred when the photo is dark, the detection is unsure, the box is small or the person is not upright. band: 1 when a dark photo had no face, plate, person or vehicle found, so the lower 45% of the image was blurred. Absent on rows written before v1.13.

low_light.description: Optional (v1.13). True when the photo was too dark to trust a found-nothing answer from the face and plate detectors, so every person and vehicle box was blurred whole.

image_moderation.description: unsafe_image comes from Rekognition DetectModerationLabels; person_dumping from Rekognition DetectLabels (a Person box overlapping a waste box).

labels.description: Labels that were flagged; empty when clean.

checks.description: Limits live in contracts/README.md. near_site is present only for cleanup after-photos.

phash.description: 64-bit perceptual hash of the original, hex.

duplicate_of.description: Earlier photo this one duplicates, or null.

note_moderation.description: Null when there is no note. A removed note is never shown; the report itself still goes on.

detail.description: Short plain reason, never a name or phone number.
